# midpoint_object (Resource)

A midPoint object of any type, managed through its free-form body.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A function library, given as the midPoint object without its type wrapper.
resource "midpoint_object" "greetings" {
  type = "functionLibraries"
  oid  = "7d4e2f8a-3c1b-4e6a-9f0d-2b5c8a1e4f36"

  body = {
    name        = "greetings"
    description = "Helper functions for mappings"
    function = [{
      name       = "greet"
      returnType = "xsd:string"
      parameter  = [{ name = "who", type = "xsd:string" }]
      script     = [{ code = "'hello ' + who" }]
    }]
  }
}

# The body can come from a file exported from midPoint.
resource "midpoint_object" "report" {
  type = "reports"
  body = yamldecode(file("${path.module}/report.yaml"))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (Dynamic) The object content without its type wrapper, e.g. yamldecode(file("library.yaml")). It is authoritative: items midPoint holds that body leaves out are removed, except server-managed ones.
- `type` (String) REST collection type of the object, e.g. roles or functionLibraries. Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) When an object with the configured oid already exists, adopt it into state and apply the configuration to it as an update instead of failing. The configuration must describe the whole object: items midPoint holds that are not configured (other than server-managed ones) are removed on the first apply. The plan warns that the object will be adopted and lists the changes the update will send. Meant for the midPoint built-ins a catalogue customizes. Without it, creating an object whose oid already exists fails and nothing is written. Defaults to false.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the object even while other objects still reference it. Without it, deleting an object of type roles, services, orgs or archetypes fails while objects assigned to it or holding it in roleMembershipRef (members) exist, and deleting one of type resources fails while shadows of the resource exist; other types are deleted without a check. Defaults to false.
- `oid` (String) Object OID. When unset, an oid in body is used, else midPoint generates one. Changing it replaces the object. Creating an object whose oid already exists fails unless adopt_existing is set.
- `options` (List of String) midPoint execution options sent on create and update, e.g. raw, isImport, reevaluateSearchFilters. When unset, the provider default_options entry for object applies, else the built-in defaults: isImport on create and none on update. An empty list sends no options. overwrite is sent only when listed here; reevaluateSearchFilters is added to any write that sends a reference with a filter and no oid.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The object OID.
- `name` (String) The object name, read from body.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is "<type>/<oid>", where type is the REST collection type.
terraform import midpoint_object.greetings functionLibraries/7d4e2f8a-3c1b-4e6a-9f0d-2b5c8a1e4f36
```
